purpose: Versioned extension of the single Stödassistenten demand/friction regression map. This mapping stores product-learning memory only; it does not prove work-injury eligibility, reimbursement amount, insurance coverage or payment.

mappings.product_miss: The public same-shell work-injury dental route already had v29-v30 synthetic truth boundaries for self-employed and invoiced-worker contexts, but every natural-language handoff still hardcoded actor_type=employee and the result layer used generic employee/Afa wording. The eval system therefore knew a distinction that the public product did not consume.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Keep one work-injury dental module. Detect only explicit self-employed or invoiced-worker language, pass bounded work_context rather than raw narrative, keep the Försäkringskassan dental-cost assessment separate from contractual insurance, ask a self-employed user only whether a current Fora insurance/ground agreement exists when that can change the TFA path, and treat an invoicing company as employer context without inferring TFA or converting the user into a sole trader.
